_how: Add one line per entry: "page-name": "video link". Upload videos to the nce-media R2 bucket (e.g. videos/nce.mp4) and link them as https://media.nextcommonera.org/videos/nce.mp4. The page name is the end of the entry address, e.g. nextcommonera.org/entries/nce -> "nce". Keep a comma after every line except the last.
